page_title: ACM 1-0 SAS | AC Milan v Sassuolo 30/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Sassuolo hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
90+1' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) sends it out of play.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Alessio Dionisi prepares a substitution. Kristian Thorstvedt is replaced by Emil Konradsen Ceide (Sassuolo).
89' Substitution. Armand Lauriente did his best and is replaced by Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo).
88' Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
84' The resulting set piece from Sassuolo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
83' Sassuolo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
82' Stefano Pioli has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jan-Carlo Simic (AC Milan) replacing Simon Kjaer.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) will replace Rafael Leao.
80' The current number of shots on goal is 2:6.
79' The ball rebounds out to Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.
78' There's an opportunity for Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
77' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kevin Zeroli (AC Milan) replaces Ruben Loftus-Cheek.

73' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom right corner, but Mike Maignan thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
70' Here is a change. Domenico Berardi is going off and Alessio Dionisi gives the last tactical orders to Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo).
69' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
68' Simon Kjaer (AC Milan) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header well wide of the left post. What a poor effort.
68' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
65' Here's the change. Nedim Bajrami leaves the pitch and Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) comes on as a substitute.
63' Stefano Pioli has decided to make a change. Luka Jovic (AC Milan) replaces Olivier Giroud.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ismael Bennacer leaves the pitch and Yacine Adli (AC Milan) comes on.
62' AC Milan are seeing far more of the ball now.

59' 1 - 0 Goal! Ismael Bennacer displays great vision and sends a pass to Christian Pulisic (AC Milan), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:0.
58' The ball is cleared after Rafael Leao (AC Milan) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
56' The corner kick from Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
56' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
53' Close! Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar.

51' Jeremy Toljan (Sassuolo) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the left side of the goal, but Mike Maignan thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
49' An attempted cross from Rafael Leao (AC Milan) is cleared.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Alessio Dionisi probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Martin Erlic (Sassuolo). He is replaced by Ruan Tressoldi.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+1' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) will take the corner.
43' AC Milan win a direct free kick in a dangerous mid-range position.

41' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Mike Maignan!
40' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 59:41.
36' AC Milan are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
33' The corner from Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) is cleared away by the defence.
33' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the top right corner and forces a good save out of Mike Maignan.
32' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) has a goal ruled out for offside!
29' The Sassuolo players are exchanging some short passes.
26' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
26' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
23' Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just wide of the right post.
22' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
20' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) displays his superb passing ability after picking out Christian Pulisic with a fine lofted pass to continue their attacking move.
17' AC Milan have been awarded a free kick from long distance, it won't be a direct shot.
14' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
14' Some neat passing and movement from AC Milan as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
12' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
10' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) jinks his way past two defenders and from the edge of the box has an effort which goes just wide of the left post.
8' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
6' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
4' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) is caught offside!
3' Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mike Maignan intercepts the ball.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. AC Milan will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Livio Marinelli.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
